section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study examining how external shame relates to body appreciation in a sample of Portuguese young adults and tests whether self-compassion mediates that relationship. Results indicate BMI and external shame were negative correlates and self-compassion a positive correlate of body appreciation; path analysis showed external shame had both direct and indirect effects on body appreciation via self-compassion.
